rows.n: COVER vaccine coverage data submission and publication schedule
rows.g: Submission deadlines and publication dates prevent use of incomplete or pre-release vaccination data.

rows.n: The state of health care and adult social care in England 2024/25
rows.g: National access, quality, workforce and inequality findings are system context, not evidence about a specific provider or parcel.
Annual-report chronology supports version selection and trend-boundary checks only.
The official publication index supports discovery and document-type checks; it creates no provider assessment or safety observation.
Selected learning cases support thematic prevention checks and are not a complete incident census or provider rating.

rows.n: Priorities for delivering more assessments and tackling aged ratings
rows.g: Assessment prioritisation and aged-rating remediation describe regulator operations and cannot establish current service safety.

rows.n: RIIO-2 Electricity Distribution annual report 2024 to 2025
rows.g: Network output and financial performance are licence-level regulatory measures, not local supply reliability or safety guarantees.

rows.n: RIIO-2 Gas Distribution annual report 2024 to 2025
rows.g: Gas-network output and expenditure measures are company-level and cannot establish parcel gas safety or service continuity.

rows.n: RIIO-2 Electricity Transmission annual report 2024 to 2025
rows.g: Transmission output and financial performance are regulatory context, not local electricity reliability or hazard observations.

rows.n: RIIO-2 Gas Transmission annual report 2024 to 2025
rows.g: Transmission-owner performance is a national network measure and cannot be converted into parcel gas safety.
Risk assessment, governance and assurance requirements are retained as data-quality controls only.

rows.n: RIIO-2 Regulatory Instructions and Guidance and Regulatory Reporting Packs
rows.g: Definitions, scope, templates and reporting timing support consistent interpretation of network-company submissions.

rows.n: RIIO-2 RFPR template and guidance modifications 2026
rows.g: Formula corrections, tracked changes and effective dates preserve reporting-version lineage and prevent silent comparisons.

rows.n: Cross Government Group on Gas Safety and Carbon Monoxide Awareness
rows.g: Annual-report chronology and cross-government scope support policy and series QA; awareness activity is not incident prevalence.
Historic carbon-monoxide incident studies support evidence discovery and series-boundary checks, not current local risk.
